title: S&P Select Sector Indices March rebalance — reference close (sizes the 03-19 witching MOC)
source: EST: date derived by applying an SEC-filed rule to the 2027 calendar. The rule is quoted verbatim from SEC EDGAR, Select Sector SPDR Trust Form 497 (accession 0001193125-26-031948, d85739d497.htm), fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 2,388,335 bytes): 'The rebalancing of the Select Sector Indices, based on the processes described above, occurs at the closing prices of the second Friday of March, June, September and December. Changes will become effective after the market close on the third Friday of March, June, September and December.' The second Friday of March 2027 is 2027-03-12 and the third Friday is 2027-03-19 (weekday arithmetic computed mechanically by this session). Filed estimate rather than SEC:/confirmed because the filing dates the RULE, not this instance — no 2027-dated S&P DJI or SPDR announcement was fetched — and because this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep
notes: DISCOVERED during the opex-2027-03-19 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05). This is the SEC-filed reference close that SIZES the largest mechanical component of the 2027-03-19 triple-witching closing auction: the same filing dates the rebalance effective 'after the market close on the third Friday', i.e. the witching close itself, so this Friday's prints are what passive managers must trade one week later. That is the single hardest-sourced fact in the March-2027 opex corridor — the witching date itself is only estimate, but the SEC primary states unconditionally that the Select Sector rebalance lands on a third-Friday close in March. Follows the September 2026 pair (sp-rebalance-proforma-2026-09-04, sp-rebalance-proforma-capped-2026-09-11) but is deliberately titled for the REFERENCE CLOSE rather than a pro-forma file release: the 497 is primary evidence for the reference close and for the effective date, and evidence for neither pro-forma release date, which the September siblings correctly had to source from methodology text instead. Low impact and market-structure only: it changes execution timing on high-open-interest names, never direction, and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4/G1) is opex- or rebalance-keyed. Derivable but deliberately NOT filed here, for the next pulse to source properly: the same 497 also dates a SECONDARY reweighting off 'the second to last business day' of the quarter, which for March 2027 is 2027-03-30 (test) / 2027-03-31 (effective after the close of the last business day) — note Good Friday 2027-03-26 is a market closure but falls in the prior week, so it does NOT move either date.
